scope: Offline review of saved local-feature evidence. No assistant inference, conversion, runtime model test or benchmark.

offlineVerification.checks: All requested image/mask hashes, observations and PTS linked to pooled report. Raw local vectors reproduce pooled descriptor. Recomputed nearest foreground/background, coordinates, colour distances, mutual flags, unique counts and weighted summaries for both reference-coverage modes.

visualReview.scope: All19 nonempty saved masks and all57 per-anchor margin panels in contact sheets; enlarged197/277/345/358. Early-anchor correspondence overlay for197 shoe vs345 wrong hand. Sparse reviewed frames, not exhaustive ground truth.

findings: Local matching gives useful partial-target evidence: frame197 shoe mean cosine .6985/.7229/.7400, mean subject-minus-background .1899/.2165/.2593 across0/30/60. Correspondence overlay concentrates its matches around earlier shoes, with some outliers.

Wrong hand345 still has positive mean margins .1589/.1340/.1233. At anchor0 its .6611 mean cosine exceeds correct partial165 .5901; its .1589 margin exceeds correct375 .1326. A generic positive-margin or single-cosine rule cannot distinguish these examples.
Correspondence overlay for wrong hand345 scatters across early face, arms, shorts/legs and shoe regions. Colour and nearest-patch resemblance do not establish the same subject.
Mixed277 retains extraneous hand area that also appears green;355/358/360 show mixed positive/negative regions with wrong hand portions still positive. No claim of pixelwise identity separation.
Fully covered reference cells do not solve overlap: at anchor60 wrong345 mean margin .1143 exceeds correct165 .0882 and correct375 .0777. Restriction reduces shoe197 cosine from .7400 to .6686.
Mutual-nearest fraction is size dependent: tiny179 yields .9286/1/.9286, while clear intended375 yields .1738/.1781/.1387. Do not turn it into an unqualified cutoff.
Empty frame300 remains empty despite visible target. Descriptor-based filtering cannot restore missing output.
decision: Do not activate normal-mask rejection, recovery gating or memory filtering from these measurements. Local parts improve descriptive evidence for shoe but do not yet establish identity separation or tracking improvement.
nextDirection: Inspect spatial consistency of groups of correspondences using already saved feature vectors and coordinates: true partial regions versus wrong/mixed masks. Avoid accepting a patch because it finds any plausible earlier skin/clothing region. Measure pose/scale and tiny-fragment limits; do not tune a threshold to this selected clip. No additional Mac run needed just to start that offline analysis.
limits: Earlier reference masks require visual review, are fixed and never refreshed. Selected later frames are reviewed examples, not held-out labels. Context, skin/clothes and lighting can confuse descriptors. No thresholds applied to output or history. Background is sparse outside-mask context, unequal bank sizes bias maxima, contextual features have broad receptive fields. Different global/local descriptors are not a calibrated like-for-like accuracy metric.
